visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of white cards, each an ordered process step with icon, title and short text

contentPattern.structure: One row per step: [icon image] | [heading + paragraph]. A single cell holding icon, heading and text also works
cells: icon: small image or SVG icon
text: step heading and short description

reuseGuidance: Use for numbered/sequential how-it-works steps. Renders as an ordered list. For generic content cards use cards.
